questions.question: Task-3 grill (governed-domain-measures): C2 requires the % nil rule with over-budget (Actual>0) vs 'credit / negative actual' (Actual<0) distinguished for zero-Budget keys. But the repo has NO server-side row/label layer — the measure expr is inserted verbatim into SQL and rows return untouched. The MIS spec itself describes the '%' column as MIXED (a % ratio, or 'NA'/blank, or an over-budget flag). How should the % measure realize the nil rule + label distinction in THIS task?
